# Noetic Organism Omega (v2.1.0)

> Exact-conservation portable C11 whole-organism cognitive engine (6,776 B/world), 825-check & 100-milestone Clean-Slate v3.0 falsification harness, and 54-theorem 6-kernel Palomar Lean 4.35.0 proof suite.

Author: Alexander Stephen Donahue (Independent Researcher, Spokane, WA, USA; ORCID 0009-0006-8168-9648)
License: Apache-2.0 (code/proofs) | CC-BY-4.0 (paper/docs/receipts)
Epistemic Notice: Not peer-reviewed; 29 cognitive checks are strictly [INDICATOR-ONLY]; 0/1,900 Mega-Atlas problems retired.
